title: Underwater Robots Reveal an Ocean Creature That Has Puzzled Scientists for Over 20 Years

title: Life Expectancy Could Soon Increase Faster Than We Age, According to a Bold Prediction
description: Futurist and inventor Ray Kurzweil predicts that medical advances could allow humans to recover an entire year of life expectancy for every year they live by 2029. title: NASA Takes a Major Step Toward Making the Moon Humanity’s Second Home

title: The Surprising Alternative to Coal That Could Transform Cement Production Is Sitting in Our Trash
description: Researchers at Adelaide University have found that fuel produced from non-recyclable household waste could reduce the cement industry's reliance on fossil fuels while diverting discarded materials from landfills. title: US Fires 24 Rockets in Arizona, Testing a New Approach to Military Training

title: This Woman Survived 30 Years of Winter ‘Hibernation.’ Her Brain Held a Remarkable Clue
description: A woman in the Netherlands experienced recurring episodes of severe hypothermia for more than three decades, with her body temperature falling as low as 31°C (88°F). Despite repeatedly entering a state resembling animal hibernation, she recovered from these episodes without developing systemic organ failure.

title: NASA Spots an Unusual Formation on Mars That Looks Like a Giant Fingerprint
description: Images captured by NASA’s Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter have revealed an unusual geological formation on Mars, where bright boulders are arranged in long, curving rows that resemble the ridges of a fingerprint. Scientists have yet to determine what natural process produced these patterns.

title: Astronomers Found Three Stars Just 28 Light-Years Away, but Their Survival Makes No Sense
description: A small red dwarf has survived alongside two dead stars, leaving researchers struggling to explain the turbulent history of an unusual stellar system.

title: Scientists Found a Child’s Fingerprints on a 15,000-Year-Old Figurine, and They Overlap an Adult’s
description: Tiny marks preserved in ancient clay reveal the role of children in Natufian art, raising questions about how prehistoric communities taught their young.

title: A 174-Year-Old Math Theorem Just Reached a Limit That No Algorithm Can Beat
description: Mathematicians have developed an algorithm that solves the Four Color Theorem in linear time, reaching the fastest possible theoretical running time for coloring planar graphs. The result addresses a computational challenge linked to a mathematical problem first proposed in 1852, when Francis Guthrie questioned whether four colors were sufficient to color any map without neighboring regions sharing the same color.

title: A Mysterious 2,600-Year-Old Structure Lies Beneath Egypt’s Mound of the Pharaohs, Hidden for Centuries
description: For centuries, Egypt’s Mound of the Pharaohs concealed traces of its ancient past. Now, satellite radar and underground surveys have revealed a buried structure dating back 2,600 years, leaving researchers with a mystery to unravel.

title: This Tiny Flower Survived 100 Million Years Hidden Inside a Rock, and Scientists Nearly Missed It
description: A tiny fossil flower dating back around 100 million years has been discovered inside a sandstone specimen collected more than 130 years ago. The find offers new evidence of how flowering plants developed during the age of dinosaurs.

title: A Shipwreck Hidden on a Remote Island for 153 Years Is Revealing New Clues
description: Archaeologists investigating a remote island off southern Argentina have uncovered shipwreck remains and evidence of a temporary camp that may be connected to an 1873 maritime disaster. The findings could help clarify how a group of sailors survived after losing their vessel in one of Patagonia’s isolated coastal regions.

title: Scientists Sent a Robot Into the Mariana Trench and Found Rock That Shouldn’t Be There
description: A remotely operated submarine has uncovered evidence of explosive volcanic eruptions more than 6,000 meters beneath the Pacific Ocean, near the deepest known point on Earth's seafloor. The discovery in the Mariana Trench reveals volcanic activity in a region where scientists would not normally expect molten rock to reach the surface.

title: Scientists Uncover a Surprising New Source of Pollution in London and Beijing, and It’s Not Cars

The findings show how changes in transportation emissions have altered the sources of pollution released into urban air.

title: Buried in a Somerset Field for Centuries, This 1,100-Year-Old Jewel Carries a Message From England’s Past

The milestone came 49 years, two months, and 12 days after its launch, marking another achievement for a mission originally designed to explore Jupiter and Saturn.
